comment: The privacy and access risks of linking health identity to civic systems are appropriately acknowledged, but the text focuses mainly on deterrence from care. Risks also include surveillance, function creep, discrimination, and access by non-health authorities.

anchor.note: p.117 l.Lines 148-155 read as the printed page; section 4 agrees

public.text: The privacy and access risks of linking health identity to civic systems are appropriately acknowledged, but the text focuses mainly on deterrence from care. Risks also include surveillance, function creep, discrimination, and access by non-health authorities.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the risk assessment and require purpose limitation, access separation, legal safeguards, transparency, audit, redress, and prohibition of unauthorised use for immigration, law enforcement, or other unrelated purposes.
